sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: Good morning, Clare House Hotel.
sentences.zh: 早上好，克莱尔酒店。

sentences.en: Andrew speaking.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁。

sentences.en: I'm the Events Manager.
sentences.zh: 我是活动经理。

sentences.en: Good morning, Andrew.
sentences.zh: 早上好，安德鲁。

sentences.en: My name's Samantha.
sentences.zh: 我叫萨曼莎。

sentences.en: I'm arranging a party for my Example
sentences.zh: 我正在为我父母的五十周年结婚纪念日筹备一场派对，

sentences.en: SAM: parents' fiftieth wedding anniversary, and I'm ringing to ask about hiring a room some time next September.
sentences.zh: 萨姆：我打电话来是想咨询一下明年九月租用一间会议室的事宜。

sentences.en: Also my parents and several of the guests will need accommodation.
sentences.zh: 另外，我父母以及几位宾客还需要住宿。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: OK, I'm sure we can help you with that.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们一定能帮上您的忙。

sentences.en: Will you be having a sit-down meal or a buffet?
sentences.zh: 您打算安排坐式正餐还是自助餐？

sentences.en: SAM: Probably a sit-down.
sentences.zh: 萨姆：可能安排坐式正餐。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: And do you know how many people there'll be?
sentences.zh: 您知道大概会有多少人参加吗？

sentences.en: SAM: Around eighty, I think.
sentences.zh: 萨姆：我想大约八十人左右。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: Well we have two rooms that can hold that number.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们有两间会议室可以容纳这么多人。

sentences.en: One is the Adelphi Room.
sentences.zh: 其中一间是阿德尔菲厅。

sentences.en: That can seat eighty-five, or hold over a hundred if people are standing for a buffet.
sentences.zh: 该厅可容纳八十五人就座；若举办自助餐且宾客站立用餐，则可容纳一百多人。

sentences.en: SAM.
sentences.zh: 萨姆。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: If you have live music, there's room for four or five musicians in the gallery overlooking the room.
sentences.zh: 如果您安排现场音乐表演，位于大厅上方廊台处有空间容纳四至五名乐手。

sentences.en: Our guests usually appreciate the fact that the music can be loud enough for dancing, but not too loud for conversation.
sentences.zh: 我们的宾客通常都很欣赏这种设计：音乐音量足够大，适合跳舞，但又不会过大，影响交谈。

sentences.en: SAM.
sentences.zh: 萨姆。

sentences.en: Yes, I really don't like it when you can't talk.
sentences.zh: 是的，我实在不喜欢那种连说话都听不清的情况。

sentences.en: TSP ANDREW.
sentences.zh: TSP 安德鲁。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Now the Adelphi Room is at the back of the hotel, and there are French windows leading out onto the terrace.
sentences.zh: 阿德尔菲厅位于酒店后部，设有法式落地窗，可直接通往露台。

sentences.en: This has a beautiful display of pots of PAllA roses at that time of the year. 3, 3 SAM.
sentences.zh: 每年此时，露台上都会摆放大量盛开的帕拉玫瑰盆栽。3, 3 萨姆。

sentences.en: Which direction does it face?
sentences.zh: 它朝向哪个方向？

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: Southwest, so that side of the hotel gets the sun in the afternoon and early evening.
sentences.zh: 西南方向，因此酒店这一侧在下午和傍晚时分能沐浴阳光。

sentences.en: SAM: Very nice.
sentences.zh: 萨姆：非常好。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: From the terrace you can see the area of trees within the grounds of the hotel, or you can stroll through there to the river - that's on the far side, so it isn't visible from the hotel.
sentences.zh: 从露台可以眺望酒店庭院内的树林区域，您也可以穿过树林散步前往河边——河位于更远一侧，因此从酒店内无法直接看到。

sentences.en: SAM: OK.
sentences.zh: 萨姆：好的。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: Then another option is the Carlton Room.
sentences.zh: 另一个选择是卡尔顿厅。

sentences.en: This is a bit bigger - it can hold up to a hundred and ten people - and it has the advantage of a stage, which is useful if 04 you have any entertainment, or indeed a small band can fit onto it.
sentences.zh: 这个房间稍大一些——最多可容纳110人——而且还有一个舞台，如果你们安排任何娱乐节目，甚至一支小型乐队，都十分实用。

sentences.en: SAM: And can you go outside from the room?
sentences.zh: SAM：这个房间能直接通到室外吗？

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: ANDREW。

sentences.en: No, the Carlton Room is on the first floor, but on one side the windows look out onto the lake.
sentences.zh: 不行，卡尔顿厅位于一楼，但其中一侧的窗户正对着湖面。

sentences.en: SAM: Lovely.
sentences.zh: SAM：真美。

sentences.en: I think either of those rooms would be suitable.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这两个房间中的任何一个都很合适。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: ANDREW。

sentences.en: Can I tell you about some of the options we offer in addition?
sentences.zh: 我可以向您介绍一下我们另外提供的一些选择吗？

sentences.en: SAM: Please do.
sentences.zh: SAM：请讲。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: ANDREW。

sentences.en: As well as a meal, you can have an MC, a Master a of Ceremonies, who'll be with you throughout the party.
sentences.zh: 除了餐食之外，您还可以聘请一位司仪（MC），即典礼主持人，他将全程陪伴您的派对。

sentences.en: SAM: What exactly is the MC's function?
sentences.zh: SAM：司仪的具体职责是什么？

sentences.en: I suppose they make a speech a during the meal if we need one, do they?
sentences.zh: 我想，如果我们需要的话，他会在用餐期间发表讲话，是这样吗？

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: ANDREW。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All our MCs are trained as public speakers, so they can easily get people's attention - many guests are glad to have someone who can make themselves heard above the chatter!
sentences.zh: 我们所有的司仪均接受过公共演讲专业培训，因此能轻松吸引大家的注意力——许多宾客都很高兴有这样一位能在喧闹声中清晰发声的人！

sentences.en: And they're also your support - if anything 06 goes wrong, the MC will deal with it, so you can relax.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们也是您的得力助手——万一出现任何状况，司仪都会及时处理，让您尽可安心放松。

sentences.en: Audioscripts SAM.
sentences.zh: Audioscripts SAM。

sentences.en: Great! *ll need to ask you about food, but something else that's important is accommodation.
sentences.zh: 太好了！我还需要向您了解餐饮方面的情况，但另一件重要事项是住宿。

sentences.en: You obviously have rooms in the hotel, but do you also have any other accommodation, like cabins, for example?
sentences.zh: 贵酒店显然提供客房，但除此之外，是否还有其他住宿选择，比如小木屋之类的？

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: ANDREW。

sentences.en: Yes, there are five in the grounds, all self-contained.
sentences.zh: 是的，酒店场地内共有五座小木屋，全部为独立式建筑。

sentences.en: They each sleep two to four people and have their own living room, bathroom and small kitchen.
sentences.zh: 每座小木屋可容纳2至4人，并配有独立的客厅、浴室和小型厨房。

sentences.en: SAM.
sentences.zh: SAM。

sentences.en: That sounds perfect for what we'll need.
sentences.zh: 这听起来完全符合我们的需求。

sentences.en: SAM: Now you have various facilities, don't you?
sentences.zh: SAM：现在您拥有多种设施，对吧？

sentences.en: Are they all included in the price of hiring the room?
sentences.zh: 这些设施是否都包含在租用房间的费用之中？

sentences.en: The pool, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如游泳池。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: ANDREW。

sentences.en: Normally you'd be able to use it, but it'll be closed throughout September for refurbishment, I'm afraid.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下您可以使用，但很抱歉，整个九月份游泳池都将因翻新而关闭。

sentences.en: The gym will be available, though, at no extra charge.
sentences.zh: 不过健身房仍照常开放，且不额外收费。

sentences.en: That's open all day, from six in the morning until midnight.
sentences.zh: 健身房全天开放，时间为早上六点至午夜十二点。

sentences.en: SAM: Right.
sentences.zh: SAM：好的。

sentences.en: ANDREW.
sentences.zh: ANDREW。

sentences.en: And the tennis courts, but there is a small additional payment for those.
sentences.zh: 还有网球场，但使用网球场需另付少量费用。

sentences.en: We have four courts, and it's worth booking in advance if you possibly can, as there can be quite a long waiting list for them!
sentences.zh: 我们共有四片网球场，若您可能的话，建议尽早预订，因为等候名单往往相当长！

sentences.en: SAM: Right.
sentences.zh: SAM：好的。

sentences.en: Now could we discuss the food?
sentences.zh: 那么我们现在可以讨论一下餐饮了吗？

sentences.en: This would be dinner, around seven o'clock ...
sentences.zh: 晚餐时间定在晚上七点左右……
